script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury retrograde in Scorpio squares Pluto in your 1st House of identity, while your ruler Uranus in Gemini trines your 9th House of truth. Saturn in Aries squares your 3rd House of communication, forcing this air sign to slow down and revise a hasty message. Venus in Libra trines your 7th House of Partnerships, so taken Aquarius faces a breakthrough through honest conversation tonight. Single Aquarius attracts someone magnetic through a community group, class, or unexpected introduction. Jupiter in Cancer expands your 6th House of work, bringing an unexpected contract or raise tied to technology or service. Avoid signing anything impulsive under this Mercury-Pluto square, because a hidden clause could cost you very dearly, especially before midnight. Follow for tomorrow's reading, Aquarius, because Uranus delivers a shock this week you must see coming.
